abstract: On Harness-Bench with GPT-6 Luna, a lean single-pass harness (`Nanobot Mode 50`, `0.46x` of `Codex 0.166.0` solver cost) leaves substantial multi-trajectory headroom (`54.80%` single-draw mean vs. `74.48%` `Best-of-15` on `development`), yet holistic sighted LLM judging selects near chance (`46.7%`). Across `520` archived episodes, `1,129` adjudication and oracle calls (`0.9961` USD), `120` synthetic episodes (`0.2040` USD), and `60` prospective `development` episodes (`0.1890` USD), we distinguish descriptive multi-draw structure from identified single-factor interventions without claiming a new Pareto frontier. Descriptively, across fixed `Mode 50` run pools, collecting already-passed gate-qualified clauses exceeds whole-workspace `Best-of-k` by at most `+0.28` points on exposure-qualified `validation`; on coupled tabular triage (`062`), symmetric `6`-permutation cellwise voting lowers exact-grid recovery from `30.00%` to `18.60%`, whereas prose-quarantined structural medoid selection rises to `58.06%` at $k=7$ (`+3.26` points) before decaying to `57.08%` at $k=19$. Experimentally, holding untruncated symmetric disagreement queries (`495` verified-distinct loci), neutral instructions, JSON schema, and leaf-path matching fixed (`556` calls) identifies two single-factor effects: on Python code (`3` tasks, `30` pairs), exposing candidate code and outcomes lowers accuracy from `55.00%` (blind) to `33.33%` (`-21.67` percentage points, pair sign-flip $p = 0.0248$, nominal 3-task `95% CI [-69.10, +25.77]`); on structured data (`6` tasks, `60` pairs), candidate exposure is neutral (`58.33%` vs. `59.58%`), while quarantining Markdown narratives lifts accuracy by `+11.67` percentage points (`59.58%` vs. `47.92%`, `95% CI [+1.90, +21.44]`, $p = 0.0125$). Finally, a `52`-word two-sided contract prompt lifts synthetic unordered-set compliance from `10%` to `100%` ($p = 0.000119$), and scores `+2.63` points (`[-7.72, +12.99]`, `1.06x` cost) on `development`.
author: abstract_repair_architect
change_summary: Resolved all three v2 review critiques via pipeline repairs, a fresh 556-call (0.4972 USD) untruncated 4-arm matched study, and full offline workspace bundling: (1) Removed all mid-object argument (950-char), outcome (380-char), and deliverable truncations in diff_witness.py and blind_witness_adjudicator.py, added symmetric leaf-diff deduplication and Stage-3 leaf-path matching on structured RETURN objects, and hard-validated ast.literal_eval input completeness and distinct candidate outcomes (c1 != c2) across 100% (495/495) of exported development queries. Repeating the matched comparison on complete witnesses strengthens the single-factor Python candidate-exposure penalty to -21.67 pp (33.33% sighted vs. 55.00% blind across 30 pairs, 11W/3L/16T, exact pair sign-flip p = 0.0248; nominal 3-task 95% CI [-69.10, +25.77] pp) while isolating a +11.67 pp companion-prose quarantine gain on structured data (59.58% vs. 47.92%, 95% CI [+1.90, +21.44] pp, p = 0.0125). (2) Added a 4th single-factor arm (sym_blind_w0prompt) testing BLIND_ORACLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT vs. neutral instructions at 0% exposure (-3.89 pp, p = 0.2861), withdrew the unsupported 3-component cross-protocol causal attribution in Section 4.3 (labeling holistic vs. locus comparisons strictly as bundled protocols), and scoped MO-4a strictly as a single-pair case study. (3) Fixed Python <3.12 f-string backslashes in similarity_extractor.py:148-149 (guarded by an automated build check), bundled lossless 9-task W0/prompt + 120 candidate workspace archives (data/dev_90pair_workspaces.json) with code/workspace_adapter.py so Stage-1 extraction, full candidate-exposure texts, and run_matched_exposure_study.py work directly from supplement.zip, and tightened abstract/Table 5 clarity and exact-grid vs. semantic-correctness qualifications.
title: Whole-Deliverable Consensus, Candidate-Blind Witness Adjudication, and Specification Fidelity in an LLM Agent Harness
